webp動態圖片流量注意。

更新進度為角色實裝滿一年，頻率約一個月一次。

將白底黑字名稱為"PART_XX"的png圖檔原圖下載之後，
更改副檔名為"zip"解壓後可獲得webm動畫(除了動畫之外還有靜態圖片轉成的影片檔)。

另外推薦可以透過此圖片瀏覽器來瀏覽動畫webp檔(Windows專用)：
https://github.com/voidtools/voidImageViewer

------------------------------------------------------------------------

WebP animations: Watch your data usage (files are large).

Updates occur monthly for characters who have been in the game for at least one year.

To access the WebM animations (including videos converted from static images):
Download the original "PART_XX" PNG (black text on white),
rename the file extension to ".zip", and extract it.

Recommended Tool (for Windows):
For a better experience viewing animated WebP files,
I suggest using voidImageViewer:
https://github.com/voidtools/voidImageViewer
